title: # Invoice - Nathan(Rusty Crewmates) - 2 month work on Kabocha (core developer)
body:
# Invoice - Nathan(Rusty Crewmates) - pre-agreed 2 month work on Kabocha (core developer) | Project Code | Date | Contributors | Status | | -------------------- | ----------- | ----------------------- | -------------- | | #EDG-RC-INV-004 | 20th June 2022 (update 6th August 2022) | Nathan(Rusty Crewmates) | Ready | _Note: This proposal has no crossovers with previously funded pallet proposals._ ## Context This is the 4th invoice from Rusty Crewmates, but the first invoice which contains a monthly fixed fee structure for the assignment of a full time developer. The improvements of the stucture of payments is showing the progression of the long term cooperation between Rusty Crewmates and Edgeware, stewarded by Ramsey(Decentration). Previous Invoices regarding Rusty Crewmates :
#001 - [pallet_mint bounty](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/discussion/4852-rusty-crewmates-pallet_mint-development)
#002 - [pallet_supersig](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/discussion/5374-pallet_supersig-joint-funding-proposal-with-w3f) partially funded by Edgeware
#003 - [pallet_subscription milestone 1](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/discussion/5778-pallet_subscription-mvp-milestone-1-funding)
----- # Assignment of Nathan for Core Development Builder: [Nathan GD(Rusty Crewmates)](https://github.com/gdnathan) Steward: Ramsey(Decentration) Nathan(Rusty Cewmates) aka "Erudyx" - introduced on multiple dev call meetings, where it was made explicit that he is working in this structure (please review recordings of meeting over the last months). _Note: This proposal has no crossovers with previously funded pallet proposals._ Nathan GD - Erudyx, is a Substrate Rust Developer, part of Rusty Crewmates, being assigned to become a contributor working specifically on the Kabocha repo.
